name: gradient-waves

frames.best_why: The wave ridges and troughs are clearly formed with the horizon glow behind them and even light across the crests.

tagline: Slow violet waves roll beneath a black horizon.
summary: A full-bleed shader seascape of soft purple waves rolling under a dark sky, lit by a low glow at the horizon. It drifts on its own and answers the pointer with slight parallax and click swells.
appearance: The lower frame is a violet sea whose waves rise into rounded ridges, catching pale lavender light on their faces and dropping into deep indigo troughs. Above them lies a flat black sky with a soft glow along the meeting line.
behaviour: The surface rolls in slow, continuous swells, crests sliding past one another as light and shade travel across them. Moving the pointer tilts the view and shifts the light source; clicking lifts a local swell that grows and fades.
search_phrases: calm waves for a landing page
use_when: A full-bleed backdrop for a moody landing hero where headings sit over the dark sky.
avoid_when: The bright lower half fights text, and the raymarch shader is costly on phones.
customise: Set horizon, wave, crest and background colours plus speed, amplitude, scale, tilt, zoom, fog, relief, light angle, grain and quality. Intro, parallax and click swell toggle too.
weight_why: A per-pixel raymarch of up to 120 steps runs across the whole screen every frame.

a11y.note: The canvas is decorative and unnamed; reduced motion stills the waves and disables click swells.

issues: The first frame is a flat purple wash before the wave shapes resolve.
polish_why: Smooth, believable rolling waves with soft lighting; the flat opening and single hue limit it.
title: Gradient Waves
